summary.para: Get the recovery point objective series.

Get, for each bucket in the half-open range [start, end), the maximum age that the newest recoverable state reached during that bucket. This API is intended for internal operator use. The range is divided into at most 1,000 buckets. A bucket has no value if no retained recovery point covers its start.
The duration of each bucket. It must be greater than zero, and the range must divide into at most 1,000 buckets.
The exclusive end of the range, as a date or epoch milliseconds.

The period to wait for the master node. If the master node is not available before the timeout expires, the request fails and returns an error. To indicate that the request should never timeout, set it to -1.

The inclusive start of the range, as a date or epoch milliseconds. When omitted, it is seven days before end, rounded down to a whole multiple of bucket_duration, so that repeated requests with default parameters return the same bucket boundaries.
